flags.title: Overlapping project locations
flags.investigate: Two or more projects cover the same road section / KM stations / coordinates do not match the stated barangay, municipality or province.
flags.instructions: Compare coordinates/chainages and boundaries across project records, then inspect any shared physical scope.
flags.safeguard: A shared coordinate does not prove duplicate funding.

flags.title: Questionable project length
flags.investigate: Cost per lane km
flags.instructions: Verify proposed lane-kilometers, pavement width and unit cost using actual scope and chainages.
flags.safeguard: Normalize to lanes, scope and pavement type.

flags.title: Repeated rehabilitation
flags.investigate: Clear engineering justification
flags.instructions: Review past bridge works, condition reports and reason for renewed rehabilitation.
flags.safeguard: Rehabilitation may be legitimately staged or due to new damage.

flags.title: No watershed or drainage master plan
flags.investigate: Project is not demonstrably aligned with the area's overall flood management plan
flags.instructions: Check project catchment and drainage connectivity against any applicable flood/watershed plan.
flags.safeguard: First establish whether plan is required or exists.

flags.title: Edited geotagged photos
flags.investigate: Verify the coordinates
flags.continuation: Verify the coordinates, capture date, original photo metadata, visible landmarks and consistency with the proposed project location. Assess any evidence of alteration using the original files, not just screenshots or exported PDFs.
flags.instructions: Check original geotag metadata, capture location, timestamps and visible scene against project site.
flags.safeguard: No conclusion of editing without forensics or original evidence.

flags.title: Not complete set of plans
flags.investigate: NBCP, NSCP compliance
flags.instructions: Determine design-stage plan requirements and review completeness and relevant code compliance.
flags.safeguard: Missing final designs may be normal at early budget stage.

flags.title: No identified water source
flags.investigate: Feasibility study
flags.instructions: Identify proposed source and assess feasibility, yield, demand and water rights as applicable.
flags.safeguard: Confirm project type and applicable project stage.

flags.title: No identified purpose
flags.investigate: No clear intended users or utilization plan.
flags.instructions: Confirm intended users, collection volume and usage/maintenance plan.
flags.safeguard: Policy/need determination is human judgement.

flags.title: Unfinished previous projects
flags.investigate: Repeated annual funding
flags.instructions: Reconcile current funding with unfinished prior contracts and accomplishments.
flags.safeguard: Repeated appropriations may be authorized and justified.

flags.title: Unsupported building cost per square meter
flags.investigate: Compare gross floor area, specification level, site constraints, building systems, and normalized costs.
flags.continuation:
Project seems to be at an acceptable cost/area but might be multi-phased, effectively putting the project at a higher actual cost/area.

Check if:
1. All works needed to complete the project are present in the BOQ.
2. The quantities of the BOQ line-items are as expected to complete the project. Line-items which are consistently "1 lot" both in BOQ and DUPA or in any way have no supporting documents to support the estimated line-item cost have a high chance of being improperly cost estimated.
flags.instructions: Normalize cost per square meter by gross area, scope, systems and site; reconcile all phases.
flags.safeguard: Compare like-for-like building specs and phases.
flags.related: Continuation note in row 14; related rows 25,35,36,42

flags.title: Repeated awards to the same contractor
flags.investigate: Analyze award concentration by district engineering office, project category, year, and contract value.
flags.instructions: Summarize repeat awards by contractor, geography, year and value after verifying procurement exists.
flags.safeguard: Concentration alone is not evidence of wrongdoing.

flags.title: Repeated awards despite poor performance
flags.investigate: Compare contractor performance ratings, defects, prior terminations, penalties, and applicable eligibility requirements.
flags.instructions: Reconcile repeat awards with verified past ratings, defects and relevant eligibility rules.
flags.safeguard: Applicable only when contractor awarded work.

flags.title: Unsubstantiated pumping capacity
flags.investigate: Verify number of pumps, discharge capacity, drainage catchment and hydraulic design against the intended flood-control objective.
flags.instructions: Check number of pumps and design capacity against catchment flows and flood target.
flags.safeguard: Hydraulic design interpretation by professional.

flags.title: Inconsistent or unsupported project quantities
flags.investigate: Compare BOQ quantities against approved plans, surveys, structural dimensions, station limits and quantity takeoffs. Identify unexplained differences between reported and calculated quantities.
flags.continuation:
Inconsistent BOQ line-items' specifications and quantities vs design plans.

Check if the specifications and quantities of materials indicated in the plans are consistent with the BOQ line-items.

For example, the concrete strength of structural members might mostly be at 4000psi but the BOQ line-items are mostly at 3000psi. In cases with concern like this, the project will surely have a substantial amount of additional cost even before starting. 

Another example, electrical or electronic wirings are mostly at 'this' indicated specs but the BOQ line-items have most of the quantities at a thicker/costlier material. Projects with this case are improperly cost estimated and might actually be substantially cheaper.

To note, DPWH might be strict in following their standard material costs but might have issues if the actual item as per design specs is not in the DPWH list of standard costs. They might have added another item in the list to replace the design item specs instead of securing quotations to support the cost of the item.
flags.instructions: Compare BOQ and specifications with plans, quantity takeoffs and station limits.
flags.safeguard: No inferred deviation if scope differs.
flags.related: Continuation note in row 20; related rows 28,47

flags.title: Unclear discharge or outfall arrangement
flags.investigate: Check where pumped water will be discharged, receiving-water levels, backflow protection and hydraulic feasibility.
flags.instructions: Trace receiving waterway, water levels, backflow control and pump operating conditions.
flags.safeguard: Site/hydraulic confirmation needed.

flags.title: Overlapping road chainages
flags.investigate: Compare station limits, road identifiers, lanes and proposed work types across contracts and fiscal years.
flags.instructions: Map road chainages and work types across years and agreements.
flags.safeguard: Different lanes or types of work can legitimately overlap.

flags.title: Unsupported pavement treatment
flags.investigate: Check whether asphalt overlay, rehabilitation or reconstruction is supported by pavement condition assessments and design criteria.
flags.instructions: Compare selected pavement treatment with documented pavement condition and design.
flags.safeguard: Judgment needs condition assessment.

flags.title: Unsubstantiated structural condition
flags.investigate: Verify bridge condition assessments, load requirements and engineering justification for proposed rehabilitation.
flags.instructions: Test rehabilitation scope against assessed structural condition and service demands.
flags.safeguard: Do not conclude unsafe bridge from budget documents.

flags.title: Unclear physical scope and capacity
flags.investigate: Verify gross floor area, number of floors, facility purpose, drawings, and intended users against the proposed budget.
flags.instructions: Verify floor area, number of floors, purpose, users and deliverable against budget.
flags.safeguard: No fair unit comparison without phase and MEP scope.

flags.title: Unrealistic construction duration
flags.investigate: Compare schedule with work quantities, equipment availability, procurement lead times, site constraints and commissioning requirements.
flags.instructions: Compare duration with work quantities, staging, weather, lead times and commissioning.
flags.safeguard: Duration risk needs construction sequencing.

flags.title: Project not ready for implementation
flags.investigate: Verify site availability, right-of-way status, applicable approvals, studies and supporting readiness documentation.
flags.instructions: Check readiness evidence and site access against legally required project stage.
flags.safeguard: Not yet due is not a defect.

flags.title: Identical cost breakdowns across different projects
flags.investigate: Compare POW, BOQ, DUPA, labor, materials, equipment, overhead and total estimated costs across different project IDs. Verify whether identical estimates are supported by separate engineering designs.
flags.instructions: Compare detailed labor/material/equipment/overhead entries; assess equivalence of actual scope.
flags.safeguard: Identical breakdown is a review trigger, not proof.

flags.title: Inconsistent project costs across documents
flags.investigate: Compare NEP allocation, BP 202, POW, estimated component costs and detailed cost schedules. Investigate unexplained discrepancies.
flags.instructions: Reconcile NEP, BP202, POW, subcomponents and project naming/version.
flags.safeguard: Distinguish component estimate from allocation.

flags.title: New or increased budget allocations requiring justification
flags.investigate: Compare the original FY 2027 NEP against the House GAB. Identify newly added projects, increased allocations, changes in project scope and corresponding supporting justifications.
flags.instructions: Match NEP and GAB projects, reconcile renaming/splits/transfers, quantify differences.
flags.safeguard: No automatic insertion allegation for unmatched entry.

flags.title: Physical target inconsistent with project description
flags.investigate: Compare stated physical targets (linear meters, structures or units) against project scope, engineering drawings, quantities and expected deliverables.
flags.instructions: Check units and physical target against documented scope, design and measurable deliverables.
flags.safeguard: Program output units may be administrative proxies.

flags.title: Conflicting document dates
flags.investigate: Compare preparation, approval, certification, implementation and project schedule dates. Verify inconsistencies against original documents.
flags.instructions: Compare chronology of preparation, approval, certifications and implementation.
flags.safeguard: Metadata creation dates may differ from approval dates.

flags.title: Project plans are not signed and sealed.
flags.investigate: Ensure that every page of the project plans is signed by the designer and includes their professional license information.
flags.instructions: Review whether signatures/seals are required for each plan at current stage and check legibility.
flags.safeguard: Don't assume every sheet requires identical signatures.

flags.title: At least one of the professionals who signed and sealed the plans are not in the database of PRC.
flags.investigate: If every page of the project plans is signed by the designer and includes their professional license information, check if the credentials can be verified through https://verification.prc.gov.ph/ .
flags.instructions: Verify apparent practitioner credentials with official PRC records where lawful.
flags.safeguard: Registry mismatch may be formatting; do not allege fraud.

flags.title: Apparent multi-phased project might be improperly phased.
flags.investigate: Check if all prerequisite works of the BOQ line-items are also in the BOQ. For example, if the phase already includes floor finish works, the phase must already have roofing and ceiling works included. If not included, it is high possible for the line-item to be damaged when prerequisite works are contracted after and thus, incur additional cost for the repair/replacement.
flags.instructions: Check whether the proposed phase includes prerequisites and a usable deliverable.
flags.safeguard: Project staging may be valid with other funded works.

flags.title: Apparent multi-phased project might have issues.
flags.continuation:
Multi-phased projects have the concerns of:
1. Legality of making the project multi-phased. Why was it not funded (or why will it not be put for bidding) as a whole finished project? Are the reason/s among the acceptable reasons indicated in RA12009?
2. If different phases of the project happened to have different contractors, there will be conflict in liabilities and warranties. Aside from that, warranties of the initial phase might lapse during the implementation of the 2nd phase.
3. If the succeeding phase will be awarded to the same contractor through a contiguous or adjacent contract, have all the requirements for doing so been met?

(for improvement, will continue later)
flags.instructions: Review legal and budget justification for project phasing, cost and intended outputs.
flags.safeguard: Full text to be confirmed; avoid blanket illegality.

flags.title: Unjustified embankment boulder-fill quantities
flags.investigate: Where boulder fill is specified, compare BOQ volume, rock-size specifications and unit rates with approved design cross-sections, geotechnical/hydraulic conditions, quantity takeoffs and applicable DPWH specifications. Look for unexplained high volumes or identical quantities at materially different sites. Request site-specific calculations; do not assume irregularity from similarity alone.
flags.instructions: Reconcile boulder-fill volume/specifications with sections, hydraulics and geological assumptions.
flags.safeguard: Geotechnical and site validation essential.

flags.title: Unsubstantiated quarry sources and hauling  costs
flags.investigate: Identify the proposed quarry or supplier, material availability, actual haul route and distance, delivery method, and haulage assumptions. Reconcile unit rates and claimed trips/volumes with DUPA, supplier quotations, delivery records (where construction has occurred) and applicable DPWH cost references. Flag unsupported or duplicated hauling charges, not merely long distances.
flags.instructions: Check source availability, assumed hauling distances and rates against route and specification.
flags.safeguard: Quarry/haul terms depend on procurement stage.

flags.title: Incomplete documents
flags.investigate: Check the main 5 requirements: BP 202, POW, Geottaged photos, Cert of Implementability, Master Plan/Feasib Study/No objection/etc. related
flags.instructions: Stage-gate each requested document: required now, later, not applicable or available.
flags.safeguard: Do not score missing optional/later-stage records as violation.

flags.title: Project Duplication
flags.investigate: Project name, location, geotagged coordinates vs Previous GAA projects
flags.instructions: Cross-check same names, locations and targets across fiscal years and contract scopes.
flags.safeguard: Avoid confusion between renewal and duplication.

flags.title: Project Cost per Unit
flags.investigate: POW vs Atlas 2026
flags.instructions: Compare like-for-like scope-adjusted unit cost with documented reference rates.
flags.safeguard: Confirm official reference version and comparability.

flags.title: Conflicting document dates
flags.investigate: Document dates vs Geotagged Photos dates (must be prior date)
flags.instructions: Compare document dates and original photo timestamps; check plausible timeline.
flags.safeguard: Do not require a rigid sequence without policy basis.

flags.title: Uncommon pay item
flags.investigate: POW vs DPWH Standard Pay Item List 2024
flags.instructions: Reconcile pay item codes/descriptions with relevant standard list and approved alternatives.
flags.safeguard: Later standard versions and special items may apply.

flags.title: BP 202
flags.investigate: Check if BP 202 and POW details align
flags.instructions: Reconcile BP202 scope, quantities, amounts and identifiers against POW.
flags.safeguard: Cross-document review, not standalone allegation.

flags.title: Program of Work (POW)
flags.investigate: Check the numbers (Acct), Check the Pay Items (Engr)
flags.instructions: Recompute POW amounts; check pay item codes, scope, arithmetic and work units.
flags.safeguard: Human engineering review required for suitability.

flags.title: Geottaged photos
flags.investigate: Check the alterations, if any and verify the exact location
flags.instructions: Check image metadata, original capture coordinates and map location.
flags.safeguard: Edited-image conclusion needs original files/forensics.

flags.title: Cert. of Implementability
flags.investigate: Check any problems that will occur prior and during the implementation
flags.instructions: Check whether certification relates to specific project, timing and actual implementation barriers.
flags.safeguard: Certificate alone neither proves readiness nor wrongdoing.

flags.title: Master Plan
flags.investigate: Check the compliance to all standards
flags.instructions: Determine applicability of master plan and assess technical alignment when required.
flags.safeguard: Standards require explicit identification.

flags.title: Feasibility Study
flags.investigate: Check the feasibility and history of project location / residences
flags.instructions: Check applicability and content of feasibility assessment, local needs and site history.
flags.safeguard: No study requirement presumed at every budget stage.

flags.title: Cert. of No Objection / Region/LGU Endorsement
flags.investigate: Check the legitimacy
flags.instructions: Confirm endorsement authenticity, project specificity, signatory authority and effective dates.
flags.safeguard: Approval/endorsement requirements may vary.
